header: The results of one project, as a row of figures
lead: Two to six measures, each with its label and a line saying how it was counted. The figure is printed above its label, which is why the visual order is set in the stylesheet rather than by reversing the markup.
note: The note carries the measurement period. Figures without a period invite the reader to distrust all of them, including the ones that are true.
